headline: Dangote Refinery Set to Become Africa's Most Valuable Listed Company
summary: A $1.6 billion initial public offering valued Dangote Petroleum Refinery and Petrochemicals at $48 billion, setting it up to become Africa's largest publicly listed firm.
why: Mega-cap listings reshape benchmark equity indexes and attract major institutional capital flows into emerging frontier markets.

impacts.name: Dangote Petroleum Refinery and Petrochemicals
impacts.why: The $1.6 billion IPO establishes a $48 billion valuation for the company.
